The '''Ekuda system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that contained the world [[Ekuda]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Alpha Squadron|Alpha]] and [[Tau Squadron]]s [[Battle of Ekuda|attacked]] the [[MC80 Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 Calamari Cruiser]] ''[[Tano]]'' in the Ekuda system.<ref name="XWvTF" />
{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Ekuda system appeared in a simulator mission in the video game ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter]]''. The game specified that simulator missions were simulations of historical battles.<ref name="XWvTF" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter]]'' {{1st}} {{C|Simulator appearance only}}
